short: Angola's 2011 data protection law is in force and its agency fined named companies in 2025 and 2026; no source found counts its decisions.
gaps: No count of decisions for a stated period has been found dated by the as-at: the APD register of 15 fines (AGO-031) and AGO-032 carry capture date 2026-10-11 and year 2026 (last day 2026-12-31), both after the as-at, so they set nothing. The 2024 PLMJ sanctions (AGO-017) name no company.

short: Burundi promulgated its first personal data protection law in March 2026; no source found reports no decision under it is recorded, and its commencement date.
gaps: No commencement date, regulations or application fact has been found; the authority is named in the law but no appointment is reported.

short: Benin's data protection law is in its 2018 digital code and was applied in 2025; no source found says how many regulations are in force.
gaps: No row carries a regulations value and no source states the count of regulations in force; decree 2022-107 is the one read as issued. No Malabo ratification is stated. BEN-004 is relayed by La Nation, not the APDP report itself.

short: Burkina Faso has a 2021 data protection law; its commission warns and inspects, but no source found says whether any sanction has been imposed.
gaps: No regulation under law n°001-2021/AN is on record. No named sanction or published count of decisions is on record; the CIL made no public report in 2024. The August 2026 bill is voted, with no promulgation stated.

short: Botswana's Data Protection Act 2024, in force since January 2025, was applied in July 2026; no source found says whether regulations exist under it.
gaps: No regulation made under the Act has been found (S.I. 4 of 2025 only commences the Act), so regulations are empty; no published count of decisions for a stated period, so application is not `reported`.

short: A personal data protection law was adopted in 2024; no source found reports no regulation or decision under it is recorded, and its commencement date.
gaps: No issued regulation, decision, sanction or count under Loi n° 24.001 is held; the World Bank (CAF-007, 20 December 2024) records implementing decrees still to be drafted. The authority is not appointed as of 28 January 2026 (CAF-002), the ministry acting meanwhile under Article 57 (CAF-004). Standing differs between sources: in force on CAF-001 (28 January 2026), the newest, against transition on CAF-005 (16 September 2025) and enacted on CAF-003 and CAF-006 (2024); the text gives no commencement date.

short: Côte d'Ivoire has a 2013 personal data protection law, with compliance checks made in 2022; no source found says whether any controller has been sanctioned.
gaps: No named decision on a controller and no published count of decisions, sanctions or complaints settled for a stated year; the 2022 control operations (CIV-004) have no count or sanction. CIV-003 does not say in terms that the law is in force, but CIV-009 treats it as operating.

short: Cameroon's 2024 data protection law came into force in June 2026, with its authority not installed; no source found reports a decision under it.
gaps: No decision, sanction or count under Loi 2024/017 has been found. The implementing decree of article 53 had not been taken and the APDP was not yet installed as at 12 September 2026 (CMR-010, CMR-011).

short: The 2023 Digital Code, in force, covers personal data; a data protection officers' network launched in 2026; no source found reports any decision under it.
gaps: No decision, sanction or count under the Digital Code is reported, so application stops at activity. Authority: the newest rows (COD-003, COD-007, March 2026) carry value none but their text says the Data Protection Authority is planned and not yet created, which fits provided (Articles 262 to 270 name it, COD-012); no source shows it constituted, and the 2024 ministerial transfer of its missions to ARPTIC (COD-014) is not shown to have been acted on. No regulation made under the Code has been found.

short: Congo has a 2019 personal data protection law with a commission inaugurated in January 2026; no source found reports a decision under it.
gaps: No regulation made under Law No. 29-2019 is stated in force, and no decision, sanction or count of complaints under the law has been found, so stage 4 is not reached. The in-force date is the article's publication date, not a commencement date.

short: Comoros enacted a personal data protection law in 2021; no decision under it is on record, and no source found says it is in force.
gaps: Commencement is not stated, so the law is not shown in force. No regulations, application or event in the last twelve months have been found. The authority is named in the law (Article 19) and, per a 2024 source, not yet constituted.

short: Cabo Verde's 2001 data protection law, amended in 2021, is in force and cases reach its authority; no source found says any was decided.
gaps: No regulation under the law is recorded either way, and no dated decision, sanction or published count under it (CPV-007 says no activity report has been published since 2016). Nothing dated in the twelve months to 2026-09-30 sets last12; CPV-010 (provided, 2024) is older than the constituted facts and yields to them.

short: Djibouti enacted a data protection law in June 2025; no source found reports no decision under it is recorded, and its start date.
gaps: Sources disagree on standing: Jones Day (2025-06-30) says passed, not yet promulgated; TechHive (2025-11-05) says enacted in June 2025 but gives no promulgation or commencement date. No regulations, application or last-twelve-months event held; the CNDP is not stated to be constituted.

short: Algeria's 2018 data protection law has been in force since 2023 and its authority issues rules; no source found reports a sanction on a controller.
gaps: No named decision or sanction on a controller, and no published count of decisions, sanctions or complaints settled for a stated period, in the 36 months to the as-at.

short: Egypt's 2020 data protection law is in force and its authority opened a licensing portal in 2026; no decision under it is known.
gaps: No named sanction, decision or published count of settled cases is reported under the law; EGY-004 and EGY-006 report guidelines, frameworks and templates only. Sources describe a compliance grace period to 31 October or 1 November 2026 (EGY-001, EGY-009, EGY-014, EGY-015); EGY-015 dates the law's entry into force to October 2020, so standing is read as in force with the grace period noted.

short: Eritrea has no data protection law as of 2026 and no supervisory authority; no source found says whether a bill is being drafted.
gaps: No regulations row has been found; with no law there are none to issue. No bill or draft is on record, and ERI-007 (2022) is older than the two newer absence statements.

short: Ethiopia published a data protection proclamation in 2024 and its regulator approved about 10 data transfers by 2025; no source found reports decisions on controllers.
gaps: No named sanction or order on a controller and no published count of decisions for a stated period; commencement date not given (ETH-001 says effect on publication, ETH-006 gives none). The four directives are not yet approved.

short: Gabon has a 2011 data protection law, amended in 2023, and its authority fined a bank in 2024; no source found says regulations exist.
gaps: No source states whether regulations under Loi n°025/2023 are issued or not. The only count of authority activity (GAB-002) gives no year or period, so it is activity, and no dated event in the twelve months to 2026-09-30 shows the law advancing or regressing.

short: Ghana's 2012 Data Protection Act was applied by a court in 2024 and against named companies in 2026; no source found reports regulations under it.
gaps: No regulation made under Act 843 has been found, and no source states there is none. No published count of decisions, sanctions or complaints settled for a stated year is held; the 2026 figures given are registrations and training activity, and the October 2026 citations name companies without a decision of the Commission's own.

short: Guinea has a 2016 cybersecurity and personal data protection law, said in 2025 to be in place; no decision under it is on record.
gaps: GIN-007 (14 Oct 2025) says only that Guinea has put the law in place and no source states its commencement; GIN-006 (2025) and GIN-001 (19 Nov 2025) speak of further or new texts with no stage or date, so they set no event for last12. No regulation, application fact or authority constitution has been found.

short: The Gambia enacted its first general data protection law in 2025; no source found gives its commencement date or reports a decision under it.
gaps: No commencement date is stated, so standing stays enacted, though GMB-010 says there is no grace period; the Act text excerpt (GMB-014) shows no commencement provision. No decision, sanction or count under the Act is on record. Authority rests on one inference (GMB-002: the Commission acts for the Act); GMB-005, GMB-008 and GMB-011 say only that it is provided.

short: Guinea-Bissau has no data protection law; the cabinet approved a bill with amendments in May 2026, and no source found says it has reached parliament.
gaps: No law is enacted. The 2025 UPR report had a bill awaiting discussion in the Assembly (GNB-004); on 8 May 2026 the Council of Ministers approved the law with amendments still to be made (GNB-006), and no source says it has since gone to the Assembly. GNB-001 (22 September 2026) says no law exists. Regulations and application: nothing found.

short: Equatorial Guinea has had a personal data protection law since 2016; no source found says whether it has been applied, or its supervisory body created,.
gaps: No regulation, application fact or dated event has been found; the Órgano Rector is named in the law as to be created by decree and nothing says it was constituted. Nothing dated since 2016-07-22.

short: Kenya's 2019 Data Protection Act is in force and its commissioner has fined businesses; no source found gives the number of decisions in a year.
gaps: No count of decisions or sanctions for a stated year: the March 2025 bulletin figures are cumulative, so stage 5 is not met. No commencement date for the Act is given, and the 2026 application facts are activity only.

short: Liberia approved a data protection act in March 2026; it has no recorded decision, and no source found says whether the Commissioner has begun acting.
gaps: No regulation issued under the Act and no decision, sanction or count under it has been found, so stage 4 is not met. The Commissioner is designated by the Act but no source says it has begun acting under it.

short: Libya's government was drafting a data protection law as of July 2026, with adoption targeted for 2026; no bill before parliament is known.
gaps: No source found says a government bill has been tabled or when one will be. No regulations or decisions under a law are on record, and the date of the committee's work after January 2024 is not given.

short: Lesotho has a Data Protection Act of 2011 with no commission appointed; no source found says whether it has ever been applied or has regulations.
gaps: No evidence on regulations, application or any event in the last twelve months. The authority is named in the law but unappointed per a source of 2026-03-23, undated within it.

short: Morocco's 2009 data protection law is in force and its authority issues guidance; no source found says whether any controller has been sanctioned.
gaps: No decision on a named controller and no published count of decisions, sanctions or complaints; no regulation under Law 09-08 has been found either way. MAR-007 says Law 09-08 was amended in 2023 with no detail.

short: Madagascar has a data protection law of 2015 and an authority seated in 2025; no source found says whether the law has been applied.
gaps: No decision, sanction or count of cases under the law is stated, so no applied or reported fact exists. MDG-009 (Jan 2026) says application decrees were delayed and absent for declarations, against MDG-014 listing Decree 2023-1541 as amended in 2025; read as issued, as the decree is in force.

short: Mali has a 2013 data protection law, applied by its authority with fines and complaints handled in 2025; no source found gives its commencement date.
gaps: MLI-016 reads the 2013 law as enacted with no commencement date; later rows (MLI-002, MLI-020, MLI-025) show it applied, so in-force stands. MLI-005 is a secondary summary of the 2025 annual report, not the report itself.

short: Mozambique has no data protection law; its bill was on parliament's agenda in October 2026, and no source found says when it will pass.
gaps: No law is enacted, so regulations and application are not held. MOZ-015 (April 2026) says the bill was already submitted to the Assembly while MOZ-005 and MOZ-006 (July and August 2026) describe it as still being prepared for submission; MOZ-001 (1 October 2026) places it on the Assembly's agenda. MOZ-013 (October 2025) says the Data Protection Office is not established, so authority stands at none.

short: Mauritania's 2017 data protection law is applied by its authority through opinions and rules; no source found says whether any controller has been sanctioned.
gaps: No source gives a named sanction, order or decision on a named controller, or a published count of decisions for a stated year; the sessions' outcomes are mostly not stated. No row states Malabo ratification, and no row says the law is under revision.

short: Mauritius has the Data Protection Act 2017, and its office reported complaints closed and transfers decided in 2024; no source found reports figures for 2025.
gaps: The 2026 DPO regulations (MUS-002) come into operation on 1 January 2027, after the as-at, so they do not count as issued; the Fees Regulations 2020 do. No figures for 2025 have been found; the bill to amend the Act for EU adequacy is drafting, undated beyond 2024.

short: Malawi's Data Protection Act of 2024 is in force and applied through guidance only; no source found reports a decision or sanction under it.
gaps: No named decision, sanction or published count under the Act has been found, so stage 4 is not met. No regulation is in force: the consultation of July 2026 is on drafts and MWI-011 is a draft. MWI-016 (October 2025) reads the Act as transition and the July 2026 sources as in-force; the newer stands, and no commencement notice has been found.

short: Namibia has no data protection law; a cabinet committee approved the bill in 2026, and no source found says when it reaches Parliament.
gaps: No source states the bill tabled, passed or enacted; the cabinet committee on legislation approved it and sent it to the justice ministry (NAM-018, March 2026), and on 13 July 2026 the minister said it was being finalised (NAM-002). NAM-001 (an opposition MP, August 2026) says no statute exists. The authority is named only in the 2020 and 2022 drafts; no regulations or application held.

short: Niger's 2022 data protection law is in force, with compliance files and inspections in 2025; no source found reports a decision under it.
gaps: No regulation made under Law 2022-59 is evidenced, and none is stated absent. No decision or settled count under the law is named; the 2025 figures are files processed and control missions. The decree abolishing the HAPDP is undated (report of 2026-06-13 used), and the newer abolition conflicts with the older constituted and provided authority facts.

short: Nigeria's Data Protection Act of 2023 is in force and applied through fines and court orders; no source found counts decisions since mid-2024.
gaps: No count of decisions or sanctions for a year ending on or after 2024-09-30 has been found; the only count (NGA-065) covers about a year to 2024-06-11, and NGA-081 counts registrations, not decisions. The Meta Final Order was set aside by consent judgment on 2025-11-03 (NGA-078), and the Amendment Bill 2026 (NGA-037) is only tabled.

short: Rwanda's 2021 Data Protection Act is in force and the authority registers and trains controllers; whether any sanction or decision has been made is unknown.
gaps: No source states whether regulations under the Data Protection Act are issued or pending. No dated sanction, decision or published count of decisions under the law has been found.

short: Sudan had a data and artificial intelligence bill in draft in August 2026, with no law yet to apply; no source found reports its content.
gaps: No enacted or in-force general law is on record; the bill's content is not described and no vote or commencement is stated. systems.csv lists a Sudanese Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority established 2025-11-07, but no evidence row says it is constituted or acts under a data protection law, so authority is left empty. No regulations or application facts have been found.

short: Senegal's 2008 data protection law is in force and applied, with figures published for April to June 2026; whether regulations exist under it is unknown.
gaps: No row states whether implementing regulations under law 2008-12 are issued or not; regulations is empty. A replacement bill is reported as drafting or in the circuit, with no stage given.

short: Sierra Leone has no data protection law, only a bill Cabinet approved in April 2026; no source found says whether it has reached Parliament.
gaps: No law is enacted: the Bill is approved by Cabinet (21 April 2026) but not yet tabled in Parliament. No regulations or application have been found, and no source states they are absent.

short: Somalia's 2023 data protection law is in force and its authority opened registration in 2026; no source found says whether any decision or sanction followed.
gaps: No named and dated decision, sanction or order under the law, and no published count of decisions for a stated period; the only application facts are registration opening and guidance. Commencement date of the 2023 Act is not stated in the sources.

short: South Sudan has no data protection law; a bill was still being prepared in September 2026, and no source found says it has reached parliament.
gaps: No law is enacted or tabled; on 8 September 2026 the bill was still in preparation (SSD-016). The Dec 2025 'announced' (SSD-003) is superseded by later drafting facts; 'none' facts (SSD-005, SSD-009, SSD-013) state only that no law is in place, which is consistent. No regulations or application held.

short: São Tomé and Príncipe enacted a data protection law in 2016; no source found reports a decision or regulations under it.
gaps: No regulation made under Law 03/2016 is on record and no commencement date appears in the captured text. No named sanction, decision or count under the law is on record, and the 2024 IBA chapter is the only source for standing. No dated event in the twelve months to 2026-09-30 bears on the law itself.

short: Eswatini has a Data Protection Act of 2022, applied through enforcement notices in 2024 and 2025; no source found reports the number of decisions made.
gaps: No published count of decisions, sanctions or complaints settled for a stated year; the newest enforcement notice on record is March 2025. No dated event in the twelve months to 2026-09-30 clearly advances or regresses the law; the investigation opened in June 2026 has no reported outcome.

short: Seychelles' Data Protection Act 2023 is in force and its commission handled 14 cases in 2025; no source found says any ended in a decision.
gaps: No decision or sanction on a named controller and no count of cases settled is reported, only cases received and handled (2024: 4; 2025: 14). No source states whether regulations are issued or none exist.

short: In 2026 Chad's 2015 personal data law is treated as in force, with a replacement being drafted; no decision under it is known.
gaps: No regulation made under Loi n°007/PR/2015 and no decision, sanction or count under it has been found; ANSICE is named for transfers, but nothing found says it acts as a constituted data protection authority. The Digital Code and the April 2026 committee would replace the current texts and are drafting only.

short: Togo has a 2019 data protection law; its authority trained correspondents in 2026, but no source found says whether any sanction has been issued.
gaps: No regulation made under the law is on record, and no named sanction, decision or published count of decisions under law 2019-014 has been found; every application fact is training, certification, awareness or a cooperation accord.

short: Tunisia's 2004 data protection law is in force and a replacement has been before parliament since 2025; no source found says the law is applied.
gaps: No regulation under organic law 2004-63 and no dated sanction, decision or count under it has been found; TUN-001 and TUN-002 (3 October 2026, including the INPDP standstill) post-date the as-at and set nothing. The 2021 members' three-year term has run out and no later appointment has been found.

short: Tanzania's Personal Data Protection Act 2022, in force since 2023, was applied in a 2025 ruling; no source found counts its decisions.
gaps: No published count of the Commission's decisions for a stated year has been found. The report of the August 2025 ruling does not name the respondent.

short: Uganda's Data Protection and Privacy Act is in force and was applied in decisions of 2025 and 2026; no source found reports yearly decision counts.
gaps: No published count of decisions for a stated period, so no reported application and no stage 5. UGA-003 and UGA-012 are registration and campaign activity with no decision.

short: South Africa's Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013 has been in force since 2021 and is applied; no source found reports the planned amendment's text.
gaps: The amendment to POPIA for AI and privacy by design (ZAF-012) is described as work under way with no bill or draft, so 'under revision' rests on that statement alone. ZAF-005's fines carry no event date (only the 2026-09 publication), so they are read as activity, not applied; they set nothing.

short: Zambia's Data Protection Act of 2021 is in force, applied so far through registration and training; no source found reports a decision under it.
gaps: No regulation made under the Act is on record, and one tender of 10 August 2026 seeks consultants to develop regulatory instruments, so none is shown as issued. No decision, sanction or count under the Act is stated; registration and training are the only application.

short: Zimbabwe has the Cyber and Data Protection Act of 2021, applied through licensing and notices; no source found says whether any controller has been sanctioned.
gaps: No named and dated sanction, order or decision on a controller, and no count of decisions for a stated period; ZWE-021 (2026-05-14) says administrative sanctions are not yet in place and ZWE-025, ZWE-030 and ZWE-032 report none.
